description: HP-45 is the Registering and Licensing Authority (RLA) for the Pangi subdivision in Chamba district, Himachal Pradesh. Headquartered in Killar, it manages vehicle registrations and driving licenses for the remote and high-altitude Pangi Valley region. The office is supervised by the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) of Pangi.
address: Office of the Sub-Divisional Officer (Civil), Registering & Licensing Authority, Killar, Pangi, District Chamba, Himachal Pradesh
